verdict.line1: No strong AI indicators in local forensics (models offline)

signals.label: No EXIF data
signals.why: The file carries no camera metadata at all. Real in-camera photos almost always include EXIF; AI generators and most social-media re-encodes strip it. (Note: messaging apps can also strip EXIF, so this alone is not proof.)

signals.label: Real photos always have metadata
signals.why: Cameras and phones embed make, model, exposure and timing data into JPEGs. Its complete absence is a moderate AI indicator.

signals.label: Multiples of 128 — common AI output size
signals.why: Diffusion models emit sizes divisible by 128 (latent-space alignment).

signals.label: Very low resolution — upscaled or thumbnail-scale
signals.why: This signal has no detailed description yet.

signals.label: Standard baseline JPEG layout
signals.why: Baseline JPEG layout typical of camera firmware.

signals.label: Natural frequency distribution
signals.why: The frequency spectrum decays like a typical camera photo (1/f noise).

signals.label: Unnaturally smooth texture
signals.why: Local texture variance is abnormally low — diffusion models tend to over-smooth skin, fabric and foliage.

signals.label: Frequency decay exponent β=0.37 outside photographic range (1–3)
signals.why: Natural photos follow a predictable power-law spectral decay; deviations flag synthesis.

signals.label: Grid autocorrelation peak at 8/16px (×1.83)
signals.why: Periodic patterns at 8/16 px intervals betray GAN transposed-convolution upsampling.

signals.label: Noise residual 0.0498 — plausible sensor noise
signals.why: Residual after median filtering estimates sensor noise. Low relative noise suggests synthetic smoothness; very high suggests post-sharpening.

signals.label: Muted palette — unusual for both cameras and generators
signals.why: This signal has no detailed description yet.

signals.label: Channel correlation r=1.00 — normal scene statistics
signals.why: R/G/B channels of real scenes correlate strongly; generators sometimes decorrelate them.

signals.label: Histogram combing — 98 empty levels
signals.why: Banded histograms appear when images are synthetically quantized or heavily posterized.

signals.label: Edge density CV 0.06 — unnaturally uniform detail
signals.why: Extremely uniform edge density is characteristic of generated textures.

signals.label: Very heavy residual (10.4) — extreme ISO, grain filter, or re-render
signals.why: This signal has no detailed description yet.

signals.label: Noise fingerprint uniform across all regions (CV 0.02)
signals.why: This signal has no detailed description yet.

signals.label: No skin-toned regions — anatomy checks skipped
